meta.parties: Naina Lebbe v. Maraikar Et Al

rules.statement: A donee can lawfully enter into a deed of partition and convey his share to another donee, thereby releasing the share from any restraint in favor of other donees.
rules.supporting_quote: "The direction about the mortgage and sale is intended for the benefit of the donees to enable any of them if so minded to purchase before others any share which might be sold. It is competent, therefore, for each of them to waive his right so as to release the share of each from any restraint in favour of the others."
